Players Committee card image of [[Eighth Brother]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May deploy or move as a 'react' to same site as a 'Hatred' card. During your move phase, unless alone, may return one of your Inquisitors here (and all cards on them) to owner's hand.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Eighth%20Brother.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Eighth Brother.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
